No. 423-A/12/28/2025-Part(2)                                                            
 
 
 
Advertisement No. 16 of 2026 
 
Recruitment of Professor in Super Specialty Departments on contract basis. 
 
 
 
ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bihta, Patna- 801103 (Bihar) intends to fill up the posts of Professor in various 
Super Specialty Departments from eligible candidates for a period of 01 (One) year on contract basis as mentioned in 
this advertisement.  
 
Eligible candidates, who want to appear in the interview, must send-  
(i) Scanned copy of Application Form with supporting documents to email: dean-bihta.bh@esic.gov.in by 03:00 PM 
of  20.11.2026. 
(ii) Original Application Form with supporting documents and original Demand Draft (as Interview Fee, if applicable) 
to The Dean, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bihta, Patna- 801103 on the date of interview  
(iii) Date of Interview: 21.11.2026. 
• Mode of Interview: Offline only.  
• Venue: College Council Room, College Building, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bihta, Patna- 801103. 
• Date for Eligibility of Qualifying Degree/ Experience- 21.11.2026 
 
(i) Details of Vacancies and Reservation position 
Sl. Department Number of Vacancy Category 
1 Burns & Plastic Surgery 01 UR 
2 Cardiology 01 UR 
3 Endocrinology & Metabolism 01 UR 
4 Gastroenterology 01 OBC 
5 Hematology 01 UR 
6 Medical Oncology 01 UR 
7 Nephrology 01 SC 
8 Neurology 01 OBC 
9 Pediatric Surgery 01 UR 
10 Urology 01 EWS 
Total 10 10 
(ii) These vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease as per the  actual requirement for the teaching &  
patient care. The competent authority reserves the right of any amendment, cancellation and changes to this 
advertisement as a whole or in part without assigning any reason or giving prior notice. 
(iii) Reservation will be as per Government of India guidelines issued from time to time.  
(iv) As per EWS guidelines posts are not carried forward , hence; in case of non - availability of EWS candidate;  other 
category candidates may be allowed provisionally to apply for the post subject to the condition that they will be 
considered for the post as an UR candidates & the selection will be only on merit basis. 
(v) In case of non -availability of reserved category candidates in the advertised post , the vacancy may be filled up for 
less than 45 Days as de-reserved seats(s). 
(vi) All Candidates must have up -dated Medical (NMC/ State Medical Council) with all post MBBS / MD/ MS/ DM/ Mch/ 
Dr. DNB Qualification(s). In case, candidate(s) do not have up -dated registration from Medical Council, they have to 
show “Applied for document(s)”  to concerned authority at the time of interview. In case, these two clauses are not 
fulfilled, the candidate either may not be interviewed or their results will remain with -held in case the expert - 
committee allows them to appear at the interview. Even after that, if, candidate selected, they must have to submit 
updated Medical Registration Certificate on the time of reporting to join. 
 
 
 
 Any Candidate can be appointed against any unfilled vacant reserved category post for 44 days with provision of possible extension. 
 
423-A/12/28/2025-Part(2) I/4624212/2026
 
  
 
(vii) Candidates working in Govt./ Autonomous/ Statutory Institution should preferably have “NOC” at the time of 
Interview from their Employer. In case of immediate non - availability of the same, copy of “applied for NOC” to be 
submitted at the time of Interview. 
 
Eligibility Criteria 
1. Age Limit as on : 21.11.2026 69 Years (Not Exceeding) 
Note:    
 
(i) The maximum tenure of such engagement will be till 70 years of age for teaching faculty whichever is earlier 
provided other rules & regulations are satisfied. 
(ii) The EWS candidates should submit EWS Certificate  (not issued prior to 01 Year from the date of interview)  as 
per Annexure - I of Govt. of India, Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions, DOPT Office 
Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res), dated 31.01.2019. 
(iii) The OBC (Non -Creamy Layer) Certificate should be issued and not prior to 01 (One) Year from th e date of 
interview. It has to be as per the format applicable for job in Govt. of India and to be issued by an Officer not 
below the rank of Sub -Divisional Officer (अनुमंडल पदाबिकारी) or Equivalent Authority of the concerned State for 
Central Govt. job. 
(iv) Reservation for PH (Divyangjan) Candidate will be maintained as per GoI norms.  
 
2. Educational Qualifications: As per NMC (MCI) TEQ Rules as amended. 
 
3. Pay and Allowances: Fixed Basic- ₹ 1,18,500/- & other allowance. Tax and other deductions will be as per prevailing 
norms. 
 
4. Terms of Contract: 
(i) The tenure of all above post(s) will be for 01 (One) year OR attainment of 70 years of age; whichever is earlier 
from the date of joining with provision of yearly extension up to another 02 (Two) years on same terms & 
conditions and pay on satisfactory performance, willingness and conduct of candidate and requirement of this 
Institution. Selected candidate has to submit application for extension every year.  
(ii) This, being a contractual appointment, absence from work for a period beyond the 07 (Seven) days  without 
proper permission of the competent authority will amount to voluntary abandonment of engagement and 
automatic termination. The teaching faculty is required to mark attendance manually as well as on Aadhaar 
Enabled Bio-metric Attendance System (AEBAS) daily during scheduled working days.  Monthly Pay will be paid 
as per AEBAS attendance marked by the person concerned for his/ her working hours.  
(iii) The contractual engagement may be terminated/ discontinued from either side giving one -month prior notice 
to this effect without assigning reason. In case of spot resignation by the selected candidate, one month’s 
salary is to be deposited to ESIC Account through Challan. 
(iv) No private practice is allowed in any capacity after joining as teaching faculty at ESIC Medical College, Bihta. 
(v) No claim for any service benefits like PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance/  Benefits, Seniority, Promotion 
etc. will be admissible. 
(vi) Acquired/ Accumulated Leave for 2.5 (Two and a Half) days may be availed for each completed month of work 
with pre approval of the Competent Authority.  
(vii) The selected candidate must have a Professional Indemnity Policy of Rs. 30,00,000/ - (Thirty Lakhs) only which 
should cover the period as desired by ESIC. The policy is meant to cover the profession liability falling on them 
as a result of errors and omissions committed by them while rendering professional services.  
(viii) Other terms and condition will be applicable as issued by Competent Authority from time to time.  
 
5. Application Fee:  
Sl. Category Amount Mode of Payment 
1 
SC /ST/ Female/ ESIC (Regular 
Employee), Defence Ex-Servicemen 
& PH Candidate 
Nil 
Through Demand Draft in favor of ESIC HOSPITAL 
BIHTA SB ACC - 2, payable at Bihta, Patna. SBI Branch 
Code- 01217. Fee once paid will not be refunded under 
any circumstances.  2 All Other categories Rs. 500/- 
 
423-A/12/28/2025-Part(2) I/4624212/2026
 
  
 
 
 
6.  Required Document(s): The self attested copy of following document(s) should be attached with application form. 
It shall also be verified with original ones before Interview/ before generation of offer of appointment. 
(i) Cert. of passing Class 10th for Date of Birth, 
(ii) All Marks Sheets, Attempt, Degree Certificate  of 
(a) MBBS (b) MD/ MS/ DND/ Other (c) DM/ 
MCh/ DrNB/other. 
(iii) Valid EWS/OBC/EBC/SC/ST Certificate issued in 
format for Central Govt. job, when applicable, 
(iv) State/ NMC Medical  Registration Certificate 
(updated) with Post Doctoral qualification. 
(v) Experience Certificate & Proof of Publication(s), 
(vi) Relieving Cert. from previous Employer, if applicable, 
(vii) Aadhaar Card.
 
7.      Selection Procedure: 
(i) The Selection will be made on the basis of acquired academic credentials and performance of candidate in 
interview before the Selection Board. 
(ii) Result will be displayed in Website: www.mcpatna.esic.gov.in and www.esic.gov.in. Offer of Appointment will 
be sent through E -mail. Selected candidates will have to join as per instructions mentioned in  offer of 
appointment. 
 
8.      Important Note: 
(i) The Candidate(s) may ascertain their eligibility and should report for interview on the scheduled date and time . 
(ii) Application should be submitted for each post separately and in the prescribed format only. The application 
submitted in any other format or incomplete application will be summarily rejected.  Wrong declarations/  
submission of false information or any other action contrary to law shall lead to cancellation of the candidature 
at any stage. 
(iii) Mere submission of Application does not confer any right to the Candidate to be eligible for Interview unless 
they report on the scheduled date and time for Interview with required documents as mentioned.  
(iv) Opportunity of interview given to candidates will be on provisional basis subject to detailed scrutiny of 
eligibility criteria. 
(v) The Dean, ESIC MCH, Bihta reserves the right to cancel/ postpone the Recruitment Process at any stage at its 
discretion and such decision will be binding on all concerned. 
(vi) Candidates may contact Nodal Officer of Recruitment Cell, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bihta, Patna - 
801103 through E-mail: dean-bihta.bh@esic.gov.in for any further query. 
(vii) No TA/ DA will be paid to candidate(s) for appearing in the Interview or submission of any document.  
 
 
 
 
 
 
            DEAN 
              ESIC MC & H, Bihta 
423-A/12/28/2025-Part(2) I/4624212/2026

TWINNING PROGRAM  
IIPM BENGALURU AND ROYAL AGRICULTURAL UNIVERSITY (RAU) -CIRENCESTER  UK  
 
Indian Institute of Plantation Management (IIPM) Bangalore introduces a twinning program 
(optional) with Royal Agricultural University (RAU) Cirencester, UK to provide a platform for 
pursuing a first -of-its-kind Post Graduation Program in Agribusiness and Plan tation 
Management (ABPM) with a scope to gain global exposure and innovative multi -cultural 
learning. Established in 1845, RAU is the first agricultural inst itution in the English -speaking 
world. The university has been at the forefront of agricultural education by combining 
knowledge and industry connections with an innovative forward thinking approach.   
 
Interested students will complete the first year of t he program at IIPM -Bengaluru. During 
second year of the program, students will spend 6 -8 months at RAU in the UK and complete 
equivalent credits as per the requirement of IIPM -ABPM program. On completion of the 
program, students will obtain PGDM -ABPM degree awarded jo intly by IIPM Bangalore and 
RAU- Cirencester, UK.  
 
Features of the program:  
 Providing an excellent opportunity to management graduates for gaining a global 
perspective on agribusiness thereby broadening their scope to be placed globally.  
 Offering a unique opportunity of exposure to UK culture and work ethics that would 
enhance global competitiveness.  
 Delivering an international academic and cultural experience through exposure to 
world class teaching methodologies.  
 Students will have to pay applicable tuition fee directly to RAU.

Technology (IPFT) for the Walk-in-Interview scheduled on 13 October 2026 under the project

facility as bio-foundry at IPFT”, the essential qualification for the post of Project Scientist-

equivalent.

equivalent.

pesticides or related areas. 
All other terms and conditions of the original advertisement, i ncluding desirable

GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS : 
 
1. The above positions are purely temporary in nature and on contract basis with co-terminus on 
completion of the projects/requirements and non-transferable to any other projects. 
2. The above positions are initially for a period of one year further extendable based on continuation of 
project(s)/requirements and subject to satisfactory performance of individual. 
3. The candidates who fulfils/meets the prescribed norms for the post should attend the Walk-In-
Interview on the schedule date and time along with CV/Bio-data duly filled & signed in the prescribed 
application format along-with self-attested copies of certificates in support of their education / 
experience / age / caste etc.  
4. The candidates who fulfil the prescribed norms of the posts notified and are desires to apply for more 
than one post shall require to submit separately their CV/Bio-data in prescribed application format 
along with all self-attested testimonials.

advertisement.

CORRIGENDUM to Advt. No.: IPFT/PROJ-RECTT/OCT/2026 dated 05.10.2026. 
With reference to the advertisement issued by the Institute of Pesticide Formulation 
Technology (IPFT) for the Walk-in-Interview scheduled on 13 October 2026 under the project 
entitled “Augmentation of existing bio -botanical pesticides and their formulation 
facility as bio-foundry at IPFT”, the essential qualification for the post of Project Scientist-
II (Sr. No. 1) is hereby revised as follows: 
Revised Essential Qualification 
(i) Ph.D. in Chemistry/Agricultural Chemistry/Agrochemicals/Forensic/Environmental 
Science/Microbiology/Biotechnology from a recognized University/Institution or 
equivalent. 
OR 
M.Tech. in Chemical Engineering or Biotechnology with specialization in 
Microbiology/Formulation Technology from a recognized University/Institution or 
equivalent. 
(ii) Three years of experience in Research & Development in the area of biopesticides or 
pesticides or related areas. 
All other terms and conditions of the original advertisement, i ncluding desirable 
qualifications, remuneration, upper age limit, interview date and general instructions, shall 
remain unchanged. 
ESTABLISHMENT OFFICER 
For Director, IPFT

GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS : 
 
1. The above positions are purely temporary in nature and on contract basis with co-terminus on 
completion of the projects/requirements and non-transferable to any other projects. 
2. The above positions are initially for a period of one year further extendable based on continuation of 
project(s)/requirements and subject to satisfactory performance of individual. 
3. The candidates who fulfils/meets the prescribed norms for the post should attend the Walk-In-
Interview on the schedule date and time along with CV/Bio-data duly filled & signed in the prescribed 
application format along-with self-attested copies of certificates in support of their education / 
experience / age / caste etc.  
4. The candidates who fulfil the prescribed norms of the posts notified and are desires to apply for more 
than one post shall require to submit separately their CV/Bio-data in prescribed application format 
along with all self-attested testimonials. 
5. Cut-off date for determining the upper age limit, qualification, experience etc. shall be the date of 
interview. The age relaxation as per GoI norms is available to eligible applicants. However, in the case 
of deserving candidates, who are found suitable, the age/experience relaxation can be considered by 
the Selection Committee subject to the approval of the Competent Authority.  
6. The Institute reserves the right to fill or reject/modify all or any specific posts as notified in the 
advertisement.  
7. The numbers of vacancies are indicative and may be increased or decreased. The number of posts 
advertised are provisional and can be varied as per the requirement of the Institute. 
8. It may be noted that offer of contractual hiring/appointment against the advertised post/s will not 
confer any right on the selected candidates for absorption in IPFT or claiming any status whatever.  
9. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. 
10. The well deserving candidates with relevant qualification and performances will be encouraged for 
Ph.D. Enrolment. 
11. No TA/DA shall be payable for attending the interview.  
 
Note: Depending upon the number of candidates, the interv iew may be continued for the subsequent days also.

ADVERTISEMENT 
 
 
 The Department of Education of Groups with Special Needs, NCERT, invites application from 
the eligible candidates to be engaged for post of Data Analyst on purely temporary basis to work on 
the project mentioned below: - 
 
Name of the Project with PAC Code Qualification 
A Study on Integration of Technology in the 
Teaching Learning Process of Tribal 
Schools: An NEP -2020 Perspective (PAC 
Code: 3.01) 
 
Essential Educational Qualifications  
• Post-Graduation in Science/  Statistics/ Mathematics/ 
Commerce/ Economics Education/ Computer Science/ 
Computer Application or equivalent with minimum 55% 
marks 
 
OR 
• Graduate with 55% marks or equivalent and two-year PG 
Diploma in Computer Application with 55% marks from 
any recognized institution. 
 
Experience 
•  Five Years’ experience in management of large -scale 
survey data management and data analysis. 
 
Desirable Qualification   
• Working knowledge of data analysis software like-SPSS, 
R, Python, Bilog, ConQuest etc. and IRT 
Age Limit Not more than 45 Years/ not more than 65 years in case of 
retired person from government organization (Relaxation 
as per GoI norms) 
Tenure (Two Months) 
 
Remuneration Rs. 68,000/- per month 
 
 
The walk -in-interview will be held on 30.11.2026 (Monday) at 10:30 am in the Department of 
Education of Groups with Special Needs, Room No. 313, 3 rd Floor, Zakir Hussain Khand, NCERT, 
New Delhi. 
The registration of the eligible candidates will start from 09:30 am onwards to 10:30 am in Room 
No. 310, 3rd Floor, Zakir Hussain Khand, NCERT, New Delhi on the same day of walk-in-interview. 
 
Candidates must bring their original certificates/testimonials along with self-attested photocopy 
of each related document/certificate for their verification and one passport size photograph at the 
time of interview.  
 
Note: 
1. The candidate may apply through email at degsnncert61@gmail.com. 
2. The candidates working with other organisation should bring a ‘No objection Certificate’ at the 
time of interview. 
3. The post is on temporary basis and only for the duration, mentioned above. 
4. No TA/DA will be given for attending the interview or for joining the post. 
5. The candidate who claims the required experience for the particular position (having consolidated 
remuneration of Rs. 40,000/ - and above) shall essentially submit, at the time of interview, an 
attested copy of the salary slip/bank statement/ITR where the experience forms as one of the 
essential eligibility conditions.

CENTRAL RESERVE POLICE FORCE 
 
RECRUITMENT FOR THE POST OF 
CONSTABLE (TECHNICAL & TRADESMEN AND PIONEER)-2026 
 
NOTICE 
 
Subject: Window for Correction of online application form w.e.f. 
21/05/2026 to 23/05/2026. 
 
  Refer Advertisement/Notification dated 08/04/2026  vide which 
notice for recruitment to the post of Constable (Technical & Tradesmen and 
Pioneer)-2026 have been published and amendment notice dated 17/04/2026. 
 
2.  Considering the request made by candidates to open correction 
window to correct/modify online application form, after closing date for receipt 
of online application form, CRPF will provide a period of additional 03 days w.e.f. 
21/05/2026 to 23/05/2026  to enable candidates to correct/modify online 
application form parameters, wherein candidates will be allowed to re -submit 
online application after making requisite corrections/changes in the one time 
online application form data as per their requirement.    
 
3.  Only those candidates will be allowed to make corrections in the 
online application form, whose earlier completed online application form 
alongwith payment of the requisite fee (if applicable) , have been received within 
the specified period. The latest modified/corrected online  application form will 
be treated as final and n o more corrections will be allowed under any 
circumstances. 
 Sd-12/05/2026 
(PRASHANT DAR)

क े  पद ं पि भती 
 
ऑनलाइन आवेिन शुरू होने की दिदि : 20/04/2026 
ऑनलाइन आवेिन प्राप्ति एवं ऑनलाइन शुल्क भुगिान की अंदिम दिदि : 19/05/2026 
 
सरकार एक ऐसे कार्यबल क े  दलए प्रर्ासरि है जो लैंदगक संिुलन को िशायिा है और दजसमें मदहला अभ् र्दियर्ों 
को आवेिन करने क े  दलए प्रोत्सादहि दकर्ा गर्ा हो। 
 
 क ें द्रीर् ररजवय पुदलस बल में दसपाही (िकनीकी एवं ट रेड्समैन ििा पार्दनर्र) की ररप्तिर्ों को भरने क े  
दलए गृह मंत्रालर् द्वारा िैर्ार की गई भिी र्ोजना / दनर्मों क े  अनुसार क े 0रर0पु0बल पुरुष और मदहला अभ् र्िी, 
जो सामान् र् रूप से अपने संबंदिि राज्ों/संघ राज् र् क्षेत्रों क े  दनवासी हैं, क े  दलए दनिायररि ररप्तिर्ों पर भारिीर् 
नागररकों की भिी क े  दलए एक खुली प्रदिर्ोगी परीक्षा आर्ोदजि करेगा।  
 
2. इस भिी प्रदिर्ा में शारीररक िक्षिा परीक्षा (पी.ई.टी.), शारीररक मापिौल परीक्षा (पी.एस.टी.), क ं प्यूटर 
आिाररि टेस्ट, ट रेड टेस्ट, िस् िावेजों का सत् र्ापन, दिदकत् सा परीक्षण शादमल होंगे। भिी की मुख्य दवशेषिाए ं  इस 
प्रकार हैं: 
 
i) आवेिन क े वल ऑनलाइन स्वीकार दकए जाए ं गे। अि: अभ् र्िी क े वल ऑनलाइन माध् र्म से आवेिन करें। 
आवेिन प्रस् िुि करने क े  दलए दकसी अन्य पद्धदि की अनुमदि नहीं है। 
 
ii) भिी अदिवास आिाररि पद्धदि पर आर्ोदजि की जाएगी। 
 
iii) शारीररक िक्षिा परीक्षा ( PET), शारीररक मापिौल परीक्षण (PST), क ं प्यूटर आिाररि परीक्षा (CBT),  
ट रेड/कौशल परीक्षा, िस्तावेज़ सत्यापन ( DV) ििा दवस्तृि दिदकत्सा परीक्षण ( DME) / ररव् र्ू दिदकत्सा 
परीक्षण (RME) क े 0रर0पु0बल द्वारा  दनिायररि एवं आर्ोदजि दकए जाए ं गे। 
 
iv) क ं प्यूटर आिाररि परीक्षा क े वल वहंदी औि अंग्रेजी भाषा में आर्ोदजि की जाएगी। 
 
v) क ें द्रीर् ररजवय पुदलस बल द्वारा िस्तावेज़ सत्यापन ( DV)/दवस्तृि दिदक त् सा परीक्षण ( DME) क े  समर् 
अभ्यदियर्ों से आवश्यक पात्रिा प्रमाणपत्र / िस्तावेज एकदत्रि करक े  उनका सत्यापन दकर्ा जाएगा। 
 
vi) दसपाही (िकनीकी एवं ट रेड्समैन) क े  पिों की श्रेणीवार ररप्तिर्ााँ दवदभन्न राज्ों/क ें द्र शादसि प्रिेशों में 
उपलब्ध ररप्तिर्ों क े  अनुसार भरी जाए ं गी और दसपाही (पार्दनर्र) क े  पिों की श्रेणीवार ररप्तिर्ााँ अप्तखल 
भारिीर् आिार पर भरी जाए ं गी। अंदिम िर्न क ं प्यूटर आिाररि परीक्षा (CBT) में प्राि अंकों क े  आिार 
पर दकर्ा जाएगा। 
 
vii) अंदिम पररणाम क े 0रर0पु0बल द्वारा अभ् र्दियर्ों के क ं प्यूटर आिाररि परीक्षा (CBT) में प्रिशयन क े  आिार 
पर घोदषि दकर्ा जाएगा , बशिे वे शारीररक िक्षिा परीक्षा ( PET), शारीररक नापिौल परीक्षण (PST), 
ट रेड/कौशल परीक्षा, िस्तावेज़ सत्यापन (DV), दिदकत्सा परीक्षण ििा भिी सूिना में दनिायररि अन्य शिों 
को पूरा करिे हों। 
 
 
2 
 
viii) परीक्षा क े  दकसी भी स् टेज क े  दलए प्रिेश पत्र डाक द्वािा नहीं भेजा जाएगा। प्रवेश पत्र डाउनलोड करने 
की सुदविा क े 0रर0पु0बल की वेबसाइट  https://www.rect.crpf.gov.in पर उपलब्ध होगी। 
अभ् र्दियर्ों को सलाह िी जािी है दक वे परीक्षा कार्यिम क े  अपडेट और प्रत्येक स् टेज क े  प्रवेश पत्र 
डाउनलोड करने क े  दलए दनर्दमि रूप से वेबसाइट िेखिे रहें। 
 
ix) अभ् र्दियर्ों को परीक्षा क े  प्रत्येक स् टेज  में प्रिेश पत्र की द  िंगीन वप्रंट् कॉपी साि लानी होंगी। इनमें से 
एक कॉपी परीक्षा क ें द्र पर जमा करनी होगी।

I अभ्यदियर्ों क े  पास वैि व्यप्तिगि ई-मेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर ििा मैदट र क ुलेशन प्रमाण - पत्र क े  
अनुसार पूरा नाम होना िादहए। इसे पूरी भिी प्रदिर्ा क े  िौरान सदिर् रखना िादहए। आवेिन िम 
संख्या, पासवडय और अन्य सभी महत्वपूणय सूिना/अलटय इसी पंजीक ृ ि ई-मेल आईडी पर भेजे जाए ं गे 
(क ृ पर्ा सुदनदिि करें दक इस मेल बॉक्स पर भेजा गर्ा ई-मेल आपक े  जंक/स्पैम र्फोल्डर में न िला जाए 
अिवा पुनदनयिेदशि न हो)। 
II ऑनलाइन आवेिन पत्र भरिे समर् अभ्यदियर्ों को सही दववरण प्रस्तुि करने क े  दलए अत्यंि साविानी 
बरिनी िादहए। अभ्यदियर्ों को अपने ई -मेल आईडी , मोबाइल नंबर और नाम का उपर्ोग करक े  
पंजीकरण करना होगा, जो प्रस् िुि हो जाने क े  बाि संपादिि नहीं दकर्ा जा सक े गा और अन्य सभी दववरण 
उम्मीिवार स् टेप-II में संपादिि कर सकिे हैं। एक बार फॉमय जमा होने क े  बाि इसे संपादिि नहीं दकर्ा 
जा सकिा। 
III आवेिन पत्र जमा करने की स् टेप-बाई-स् टेप प्रदिर्ा नीिे िी गई है: 
स् ट्ेप-I: व्यप्तिगि और संपक य  दववरण का पंजीकरण। लॉदगन आईडी और पासवडय आपको पंजीक ृ ि 
ई-मेल आईडी पर ई-मेल क े  माध्यम से भेजा जाएगा। 
स् ट्ेप-II: दफर से लॉदगन करें और श्रेणी का िर्न करें और व्यप्तिगि दववरण , पिा दववरण, अहयिा 
दववरण, उपलप्तब्धर्ों का दववरण, आवेदिि पि भरें ििा इसक े  बाि प्रमाण पत्र एवं कागजाि (फोटो एवं 
हस्ताक्षर इत्यादि) अपलोड करें और परीक्षा शुल्क (र्दि लागू हो) और "सेवा प्रभार" सभी अभ्यदियर्ों द्वारा 
भुगिान दकर्ा जाना है, िाहे कोई भी श्रेणी हो, ऑनलाइन भुगिान नेट बैंदक ं ग/डेदबट काडय/ि े दडट काडय/ 
र्ूपीआई/सीएससी वॉलेट क े  माध्यम से  करें। 
IV एक बार जमा दकर्ा गर्ा आवेिन वापस नहीं दलर्ा जा सकिा है और एक बार भुगिान दकर्ा गर्ा शुल्क 
दकसी भी प्तस्थदि में वापस नहीं दकर्ा जाएगा , र्ह न िो दकसी अन्य भिी क े  दलए और न ही भदवष्य में 
िर्न प्रदिर्ा क े  दलए आरदक्षि रखा जाएगा। 
स् ट्ेप - I पंजीकिण: 
ए दनर्म और शिों से सहमि अभ्यिी नीिे दिए गए 'मैं सहमि हं ' िेकबॉक्स पर प्तिक करक े  और

बी अभ् र्दियर्ों को सभी आवश्यक जानकारी र्िा-व्यप्तिगि दववरण , पिा दववरण , अहयिा दववरण ,

GOVERNMENT STRIVES TO HAVE A WORKFORCE WHICH REFLECTS 
GENDER BALANCE AND WOMEN CANDIDATES ARE ENCOURAGED TO 
APPLY 
 
 The CRPF will conduct an open competitive examination for recruitment 
of Indian citizens against vacancies prescribed for Male and Female 
candidates who are ordinarily residents of their respective States/UTs to fill 
up the vacancies of Constable (Technical & Tradesmen and Pioneer) in Central 
Reserve Police Force as per the Recruitment Scheme/Rules formulated by the 
Ministry of Home Affairs/CRPF. 
 
2. The recruitment process will consist of Physical Efficiency Test (PET), 
Physical Standards Test (PST), Computer Based Test, Trade Test, Document 
Verification and Medical Examination. The salient features of the recruitment 
are as under: 
 
i) Applications will be accepted ONLINE only. Hence, candidates are 
required to apply only online. No other mode for submission of 
application is allowed. 
 
ii) Recruitment will be conducted on domicile-based pattern. 
 
iii) Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Physical Standard Test (PST), Computer 
Based Test (CBT), Trade/Skill Test, Document Verification (DV) and 
Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination 
(RME) will be scheduled and conducted by the CRPF. 
 
iv) Computer Based Test will be conducted in English and Hindi only. 
 
v) Collection of required eligibility certificates/documents from the 
candidates and their verification will be carried out at the time of  
Document Verification  (DV)/Detailed Medical Examination (DME) by 
the CRPF. 
 
vi) Category wise vacancies of Constable (Technical  & Tradesmen) will be 
filled as per the vacancies available in various States/UTs and category 
 
Page 2 of 47 
 
wise vacancies for the post of Constable (Pioneer) will be filled on All 
India Basis. Final selection will be made on the basis of marks obtained 
in Computer Based Test (CBT). 
 
vii) Final result will be declared by the CRPF based on the performance of 
candidates in the Computer Based Test (CBT) subject to their qualifying 
the PET, PST, Trade/Skill Test, Document Verification ( DV), Medical 
Examination and other conditions stipulated in the Recruitment Notice. 
 
viii) Admit card for any stage of examination will not be sent by post . 
Facility for download of admit cards will be provided at the website of 
CRPF https://www.rect.crpf.gov.in Candidates are advised to 
regularly visit the website of the CRPF for the updates on examination 
schedule and download Admit Cards for each stage of examination. 
 
ix) The candidates should bring two colored print out of admit card at the 
time of each stage of examination. One copy of admit card will be 
handed over at the Examination Centre.

2. Who has been released from such service after completing the specific 
period of engagement, otherwise than at his own request, or by way of 
dismissal, or discharge on account of misconduct or inefficiency and 
has been given a gratuity; and includes personnel of th e Territorial

service with pension, or are released from the Army Postal service on 
medical grounds attributable to or aggravated  by military service or 
circumstance beyond their control and awarded medical or other 
disability pension; 
 
OR 
 
4. Personnel, who were on deputation in Army Postal Service for more than 
six months prior to the 14th April, 1987; 
 
OR 
 
5. Gallantry award winners of the Armed Forces including personnel of 
Territorial Army. 
 
OR 
 
6. Ex-recruits boarded out or relieved on medical ground and granted 
medical disability pension.

i) The syllabus for the Examination will be as follows:

ability to observe and distinguish patterns will be tested through 
questions principally of non -verbal type. This component may 
include questions on analogies, similarities and differences, spatial 
visualization, spatial orientati on, visual memory, discrimination, 
observation, relationship concepts, arithmetical reasoning and 
figural classification, arithmetic number series, non -verbal series, 
coding and decoding etc. 
 
2. General Knowledge and General Awareness : Question in this 
component will be aimed at testing the candidate’s general 
awareness of the environment around him. Questions will also be 
designed to test knowledge of current events and of such matters of 
every day observations and experience in their scientific aspect as 
may be expected of any educated person. The test will also include 
questions relating to India and its neighboring countries especially 
pertaining to sports, History, Culture, Geography, Economic 
Science, General Policy, Indian Constit ution, Scientific Research 
etc. These questions will be such that they do not require a special 
study of any discipline. 
 
3. Elementary Mathematics : This paper will include questions on 
problems relating to Number Systems, Computation of whole 
numbers, Decimals and Fractions and relationship between 
numbers, Fundamental arithmetical operations, Percentages, Ratio 
and Proportion, Averages, Interest, P rofit and loss, Discount, 
Mensuration, Time and Distance, Ratio and Time, Time and work 
etc. 
 
4. English/Hindi: Candidate’s ability to understand basic 
English/Hindi and his/her basic comprehension would be tested.

PROCEDURE FOR ONLINE SUBMISSION OF APPLICATION 
 
Steps to Apply: 
 
I Candidates should have a valid personal e -mail ID & mobile number 
and Full Name as per Matriculation. It should be kept active during the 
entire recruitment process. Application sequence number, password & 
all other important communication/ alerts will be sent on the same 
registered e-mail ID (please ensure that e -mail sent to th is mailbox is 
not redirected to your junk/spam folder). 
II Candidates should take utmost care to furnish the correct details while 
filling in the on -line application form. Candidates have to register by 
using their e-mail ID, Mobile Number and Name which cannot be edited 
once submitted. and all other details can be edited by the candidate in 
Step-II. Once the form is submitted, it can’t be edited. 
III The step-by-step process for submitting the application form is given 
below: 
Step-I: Registration of personal & contact details. Login ID and 
password will be sent to candidates on their registered e-mail ID. 
Step-II: Re-login and select the category and fill up the personal details, 
Address Details, qualification details, Achievement Details, applied post 
and then upload certificate & Documents (i.e. photo & signature etc.) 
and submit “Examination Fees (if applicable)” and “Service Charges” to 
be paid by the candidates irrespective of category, online Payment 
should be done through net banking/debit cards/credit 
cards/UPI/CSC Wallet. 
IV Application once submitted cannot be withdrawn and fee once paid will 
not be refunded in any case, neither shall it be held reserved for any 
other recruitment nor selection process in future. 
STEP-I Registration: 
a. Candidates agreeing the terms & conditions may apply by clicking ‘I 
Agree’ checkbox given below and pressing the ‘Start’ button. 
b. The candidates should fill up all the desired information i.e. personal 
details, Address Details, qualification details, Achievement Details, 
applied post etc. and then upload certificate & Documents ( like photo 
& signature), etc. correctly. 
c. On completion of Step -I registration, a message will be received in 
candidate’s registered email ID conveying his/her login ID (Application 
Sequence Number) & Password. 
d. The candidates have to log-out and log-in again (for Step-II) in order to 
fill up other details in application form. 
STEP-II Completion of Application form: 
e. After registration, candidates have to login and complete other details 
in application form like Personal Details, Address Details, Achievement 
Details, Qualification Details, and Declaration etc. 
f. Instructions regarding scanning of Photograph and Signature: 
Candidates should upload the scanned (digital) image of their 
photograph and signature as per the process given below. The applicant 
should note that only JPG/JPEG format is acceptable: 
i. Photograph image: 
 
Page 38 of 47 
 
• Latest colored photo of size 35mm (width) x 45mm (height). Black & 
white photo will not be accepted. 
• Light background. Light grey/white is suggested. No patterns. 
• The face should cover 70 -80% of the photo. The applicant should 
look straight at the camera with a normal expression. 
• Avoid uniforms of colors matching the background. 
• If the applicant wears optical glasses, then his/her eyes should be 
fully visible and should not wear caps etc. 
• The size of the scanned image should be between 50 -100 kb in 
JPG/JPEG/PNG format only. 
ii. Signature image: 
• The applicant have to sign on white paper with Black ink pen. 
• The signature must be signed only by the applicant and not by any 
other person. 
• Please scan the signature area only and not the entire page. 
• Size of file should be between 50 -100 kb in JPG/JPEG/PNG format 
only. 
iii. Documents size: 
• Size of file should be between 100 -500 kb in JPG/JPEG/PNG/PDF 
format only.  
g. Once the application is submitted, candidates will be automatically 
redirected to Payment gateway to deposit the examination fee of INR 
100 (if applicable) and Service Charges for each post applied for, to 
be paid by all candidates, through Debit Card/Credit Card/ Net 
Banking/UPI/CSC wallet etc. Candidates may generate payment 
acknowledgement slip for future reference. 
h. Guidelines for remittance of fee are as under: 
• Post submission, the candidate will be re -directed to Payment 
Gateway to make the online payment. 
• Kindly verify the details and make the payment for application fees 
via different payment modes. 
• Post successful online payment will be redirected to his/her 
application form. 
i. For the purpose of all future references, the candidates are advised to 
keep a printout of their application form after successful submission. 
j. For technical queries/clarifications relating the filling up of ONLINE 
APPLICATION, please feel free to contact at CRPF helpline number 011-
26160255 on working days  (i.e. Monday to Friday  between 10:00 
to 18:00 hrs).
